issues.description: React hydration errors - text content does not match server-rendered HTML (7 instances), causing entire root to switch to client rendering
issues.root_cause: A component in apps/web/app/auth/page.tsx (or a child component) is rendering dynamic content differently on server vs client. Common causes: using Math.random(), Date, window, or browser-only APIs without 'use client' directive, or conditional rendering based on client-only state (e.g., localStorage). The password SHOW/HIDE toggle or a timestamp/dynamic value likely reads browser state during SSR.

fixes.reason: If the auth page uses 'use server' but has interactive client state (password show/hide toggle, form state), it causes hydration mismatches. Marking as 'use client' ensures consistent rendering.
